title: filago germanica subsp. spathulata
intro: Filago germanica subsp. spathulata, commonly known as narrow-leaved cotton grass, is a flowering plant species within the family Asteraceae, known for its medicinal properties. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, helping to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of narrow-leaved cotton grass include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune response, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
